scene_1_caticlan_jetty_departure.speaker: Rose
scene_1_caticlan_jetty_departure.text: iya eon kita sa Caticlan. Sunod, sakay kita pa-Boracay.
scene_1_caticlan_jetty_departure.translation: We’re here at Caticlan. Next, we ride to Boracay.

scene_1_caticlan_jetty_departure.speaker: Papa Jobert
scene_1_caticlan_jetty_departure.text: Grabe, kaabo nga turista. Same as before, maybe even more now.
scene_1_caticlan_jetty_departure.translation: Wow, so many tourists. Same as before, maybe even more now.

scene_2_arrival_at_boracay_white_beach.speaker: Tita Beth
scene_2_arrival_at_boracay_white_beach.text: Mayad-ayad nga agahon, mga bisita! Welcome sa Boracay.
scene_2_arrival_at_boracay_white_beach.translation: Good morning, visitors! Welcome to Boracay.

scene_2_arrival_at_boracay_white_beach.speaker: Rose
scene_2_arrival_at_boracay_white_beach.text: This is my aunt, Tita Beth. She works in tourism here.

scene_2_arrival_at_boracay_white_beach.speaker: Tita Beth
scene_2_arrival_at_boracay_white_beach.text: iya kamo para magpahuway ag ma-enjoy ro baybay.
scene_2_arrival_at_boracay_white_beach.translation: You’re here to rest and enjoy the shore.

scene_3_tourism_lesson.speaker: Tita Beth
scene_3_tourism_lesson.text: ro turismo iya ro naga-suporta sa komunidad. bukon sa eamang sa negosyo, kundi pati sa trabaho it tanan.
scene_3_tourism_lesson.translation: Tourism here supports the community. Not just business, but jobs for everyone.

scene_3_tourism_lesson.speaker: Player
scene_3_tourism_lesson.text: So every visitor helps the locals too?

scene_3_tourism_lesson.speaker: Tita Beth
scene_3_tourism_lesson.text: hara gid. Kung magbakae ka sapag-obra, bukon eang souvenir — kundi suporta sa tawo nga nagahimo.
scene_3_tourism_lesson.translation: Exactly. When you buy a craft, it’s not just a souvenir — it’s support for the person who made it.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_touris.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_touris.text: Sakay — ride. Pahuway — rest. Eangoy — swim. Baybay — shore.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_touris.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_touris.text: Balik — return. Warang— travel. Bisita — visitor. Turista — tourist.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_touris.speaker: Player
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_touris.text: Okay, turista is me right now.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_touris.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_touris.text: Correct. But you’re also balikbayan — returning home.

scene_5_finale_reflection.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_5_finale_reflection.text: indi ko malipatan do pag warang natun ngara, daya hay paeanumdum sa akong kabuhi .
scene_5_finale_reflection.translation: I’ll never forget this trip. It feels like a memory of my life.

scene_5_finale_reflection.speaker: Rose
scene_5_finale_reflection.text: And worth every word you’ve learned, balikbayan.

scene_5_finale_reflection.speaker: Tita Beth
scene_5_finale_reflection.text: dahan ka sa  pagbalik mo. ag ayaw pag lipati ro Aklan.
scene_5_finale_reflection.translation: Take care on your return. And don’t forget Aklan.

idle_pool_tita_beth.speaker: Tita Beth
idle_pool_tita_beth.text: Damo turista gapunta diri, pero pila lang gid ang nagabalik sa Kalibo. Ikaw lain siguro, ha?
Inaayos ni Tita Beth ang mga life vest, kausap-kausap pa rin ang grupo.

idle_pool_tita_beth.speaker: Tita Beth
idle_pool_tita_beth.text: Ang Boracay, maganda gid. Pero ang Aklan, amo ang tunay nga puso namon.

idle_pool_tita_beth.speaker: Tita Beth
idle_pool_tita_beth.text: Kung balik kamo, sabihi ako. Libre ang sakay, para sa pamilya ni Jonabel.
Tumingin si Tita Beth sa papalayong bangka, tumango-tango, ngiting-ngiti.

idle_pool_tita_beth.speaker: Tita Beth
idle_pool_tita_beth.text: Ang dagat, damo naka-agi rira. Damo man ang nagbalik. Ikaw, isara na sa ila.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Kadugay ko na di nakatilaw sang kan-on nga tumbien sa balay ni Susan.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Player, do not forget to write to your Lola back home too. Distance should never mean silence.
Napahiling si Lola Jonabel sa bintana, nakangiti nang walang partikular na dahilan.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Kung pagod ka na, Apo, sabihin mo lang. Hindi kailangan lahat ngayon din matutunan.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: This town raised me before it raised your Tita Susan. Funny how it still feels the same.
Hinihipo ni Lola Jonabel ang lumang litrato sa kanyang bag, hindi napapansin na napapangiti siya.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Marami pang lugar dito na gusto kong ipakita sa'yo, Apo. Isa-isa lang.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Alam mo, kahit gaano man katagal, parang kailan lang 'yong huling beses ko dito.
Hinawakan ni Lola Jonabel ang piña cloth nang matagal, tila naaalala ang sarili niyang lola.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: My own lola wove like this too, Apo. Small world, isn't it — some things never change here.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: Ingatan mo 'yang bookmark. It's not just cloth, it's somebody's years of patience.
Nakatingin si Lola Jonabel sa dagat nang matagal, mukhang kontento, hindi na malungkot.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: This isn't a goodbye, Apo. It never really was. We just carry it with us now.

idle_pool_lola_jonabel.speaker: Lola Jonabel
idle_pool_lola_jonabel.text: I used to think coming home meant staying forever. Now I know it just means never really leaving.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Grabe 'to, parang bata ulit ako pag nandito. Sobrang dami ng memories, anak.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Huwag kang mag-alala kay Rose, ganyan talaga siya. Marunong naman siya magturo, promise.
Kinukuha ni Papa Jobert ang kanyang phone, kunwari kukuha ng litrato pero halatang nostalgic lang.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Alam mo, dito rin ako natutong mag-Akeanon dati. Parang paulit-ulit lang 'yung kwento, ha.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Sabihin mo kay Lola kung kailan ka na-tire. Alam mo naman siya, hindi siya titigil sa excitement.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Sobrang saya ni Lola ngayon, no? Sulit lahat ng jetlag para diyan.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Kung may makalimutan tayo, ako na bahala. Ikaw, focus ka lang sa pag-aaral.
Napapatango-tango si Papa Jobert habang naglalakad, parang bawat kanto may kwento.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Grabe, ang linis ngayon kumpara noon. Manong Ambo really did something here.
Kinunan ni Papa Jobert ng litrato ang paglubog ng araw, tahimik na tahimik.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Sabi ni Lola dati, mas maganda raw dito kaysa kahit saan. Mukhang tama siya.

idle_pool_papa_jobert.speaker: Papa Jobert
idle_pool_papa_jobert.text: Anak, proud ako sa'yo. Hindi ko inexpect na ganito ka-seryoso ka mag-aral nito.
Kinukuha ni Papa Jobert ang huling litrato ng buong pamilya, hindi na kunwari ang ngiti ngayon.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Halong, apo — mainit gid diri sa Aklan, indi pareho sa America.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Kung gutom ka, sabihon mo lang. Damo pagkaon sa balay.
Ngumiti si Lola Susan, hinahaplos ang balikat ni Jonabel na parang natatakot pang mawala ulit ito.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Rose is a good girl, ha. Sharp lidah lang — sharp tongue. Her heart is bigger than that mouth.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Sabihin mo sa akin kung ano pa gusto mong makita dito. Ipapakita ko lahat.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Dati pa, magkasama kami ni Jonabel sa lahat. Ngayon, ikaw naman ang kasama niya.
Kinukuha ni Lola Susan ang bag ni Player nang hindi man lang pinapayagan siyang tumanggi.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Indi ka gid mabudlayan diri, Apo. Kilala ka namon tanan.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Ari, tan-awa ang simbahan. Kadamo ka gid memories diri, apo.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Halong ka lang sa init, indi ka anad diri sa Aklan.
Tumango si Lola Susan sa mga kakilala habang naglalakad papasok ng market.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Kung may gusto ka pamangkin, sabihon mo lang kay Manong Pedring. Suki namon 'to.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Rose is teaching you well, no? She's stubborn, but her heart is in the right place.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Sadto pa, amo ni akon paborito nga bahin sang tuig. Wala nagbag-o.
Kinunan ni Lola Susan ng litrato si Player habang nagpaparticipate sa call-response.

idle_pool_lola_susan.speaker: Lola Susan
idle_pool_lola_susan.text: Balik kamo, ha. Indi ni ang huling beses — promise mo sa akon 'na.
Niyakap ni Lola Susan si Player nang mahigpit bago sila umalis, ayaw pang bitawan.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Wag mo akong tignan nang ganyan, hindi ako tour guide. ...okay, konti lang.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Magtuon ka gid, ha. Indi lang basta-basta.
Tumingin si Rose sa Player nang matagal, parang sinusukat kung seryoso ba talaga siya.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: My Lola Susan talks about your Lola Jonabel parang superhero pa. Big shoes to fill, balikbayan.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Fine, you're not completely hopeless. ...don't let that get to your head.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Alam mo, hindi ko rin naman gustong magturo dati. Pero, sige na nga.
Napailing si Rose, pero halatang pigil ang ngiti.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Wag kang mag-expect ng slack sa 'kin kasi pinsan ka daw ni Tita Susan. Rules apply to everyone.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Stop overthinking the pronunciation. Just say it. Worst case, I laugh at you.
Tumingin si Rose sa mapa, tapos kay Player, parang sinusukat ang route.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Manong Pedring likes you. That's rare — he's picky about balikbayans.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Magbulig ako sa imo, pero indi ako mangin madali. Deal pa rin 'yun.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: You're actually trying. Didn't expect that, not gonna lie.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: I actually like it here. Don't tell Manang Loleng I said that, she'll never let me hear the end of it.
Tinitignan ni Rose ang unang linya ng weaving ni Player, tapos tumango, medyo impressed.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: You're better at this than the greeting stuff, honestly. Weird flex, but okay.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Magtuon ka pa sang isara ka leksyon, tapos indi ka na "balikbayan" sa akon. Promise.
Nag-iisa si Rose sa dulo ng bangka, tinitignan ang tubig nang tahimik.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Manong Ambo's basically family. He used to carry me on his shoulders here, ages ago.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: This place calms me down. Don't get used to seeing me like this though.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: This is my favorite time of year. Don't tell anyone I said that either.
Sumasayaw nang bahagya si Rose habang naglalakad, hindi napapansin.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: You did better than I expected out there. Seriously.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Sunod tuig, ikaw na mismo mag-lead sang banner. Deal?

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: You're not completely hopeless, balikbayan. I said it before, I'll say it again — don't let it get to your head.
Iniabot ni Rose ang isang tinatawag niyang "starter list" ng mga susunod na salita, hindi umaamin na effort 'yon.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Text me when you land back home. Not because I care or whatever. Just — text me.

idle_pool_rose.speaker: Rose
idle_pool_rose.text: Summary — full script status (amended, vocab-sequenced)
